Concept A Detail Check

Printable-level CAD of the claw + wrist flip + turntable robot. The motion is the Arduino sequence (same angles and order as concept_a.ino) driving the real part geometry. Every pose was collision-checked with solid booleans. Purchased parts use datasheet envelopes: measure yours before printing.

HOMEOperator lifts the can off, then presses START to home

Turntable D9–
Lift D10–
Wrist D6–

Turret angle–
Lift height–
Wrist roll–
Arms open–
